{{Quote|The Glorious Radiance was of interest to me, as it is described as an energy that radiates from the goddess, connecting her to all life in the galaxy. This sounds like how the Jedi describe the Force, and indeed Sister Sigil explained that her order once had many Force-sensitives.|Tash Arranda, ''Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd, Or: What I Did On My Inter-Term Break''|<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html?page=1|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd: A Hyperspace Exclusive|int=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}</ref>}}
The '''Glorious Radiance''' was one of two aspects of the [[God/Legends|goddess]] [[Via]], worshipped by followers of [[Vianism]]. The other aspect was [[Beatific Countenance]]. It was described as being similar to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] since it connected Via to all life in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd" />
